blocks.text: The legendary account of siddhis continues briefly before the story shifts toward the next conflict, where Ali Singh appears in anxiety before Banda and receives a dark prediction about his sons.
The warning is specific and martial: within two days artillery and battle will bring the threatened death to fulfillment, linking supernatural foreknowledge with impending violence.
By centering Ali Singh here, the page uses prophecy to bridge miraculous reputation and the next concrete episode of warfare.
